questions.question: A deposited ₹8,000 in a bank at 8% per annum simple interest. B deposited ₹6,000 at 10% compound interest per annum. After 3 years the difference between their interest will be:
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

A's principle = 8,000

Rate = 8% at S.I.

B's principle = 6,000

Rate = 10%at C.I.

**FORMULA USED:**

S.I. = ( P × R × T )/100 

A = P × ( 1 +R/100)^t

C.I. = Amount - Principle 

Where, A = Amount , S.I. = Simple Interest, C.I.= Compound Interest 

 P = Principle, R = Rate , t = time in years 

**CALCULATION:**

As, we have, A's Principle = Rs8,000 , Rate = 8% , Time = 3 years

⇒ S.I. = ( P × R × T)/100 = ( 8000 × 8 × 3)/100 = Rs1,920.

Now, we have B's Principle = Rs6,000, Rate = 10% , Time = 3 years 

⇒ A = P × ( 1 + R/100)^t 

⇒ A = 6000 × ( 1 +10/100)³ = 6000 × 11/10 × 11/10 × 11/10 = Rs7,986.

Now, the Compound Interest = (Amount - Principle) = (7986 - 6000) = Rs1,986

After 3 years, Difference = (1,986 - 1,920) = Rs66.

**Hence, the required difference after 3 years is Rs66.**

questions.question: The length of a rectangle is three-fifths of the radius of a circle. The radius of the circle is equal to twice the side of a square, whose area is 3025 sq. units. The breadth of the rectangle is one-fifth of the side of the square. What is the area (in sq. units) of the rectangle?
questions.solution:

Length of a rectangle = 3/5 of the radius of a circle 

Radius of a circle = 2 side of a square 

Area of a square = 3025 sq. units 

Breadth of a rectangle = 1/5 of the side of the square

**FORMULA USED:**

Area of a rectangle = Length × Breadth

Area of a square = (side)²

**CALCULATION:**

Let us assume side of a square be a 

Now, Radius = 2a 

⇒ Area of a square = 3025

⇒ (a)² = 3025 

⇒ a = 55 

Now, Radius = 2a = 2 × 55 = 110

Now, Length of a rectangle = 3/5 of the radius of a circle = 3/5 × 110 = 66

Breadth of a rectangle = 1/5 × a = 1/5 × 55 = 11 

⇒ Area of a rectangle = Length × Breadth = 66 × 11 = 726 sq. units

**Hence, Area of a rectangle is 726 sq. units.**

questions.question: Find the smallest 4-digit number which when divided by 2, 3 and 5 leaves a remainder of 1 in each case?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Smallest 4 - digit number leaves 1 remainder when divided by 2,3 and 5 

**CONCEPT USED;**

Lowest Common Multiple (L.C.M) 

The smallest four digit number is 1000

**CALCULATION:**

L.C.M of 2,3 and 5 

⇒ Prime factorization

2 = 2 × 1

3 = 3 × 1 

5 = 5 × 1 

⇒ L.C.M = 2 × 3 × 5 ×1 = 30 

When we divide 1000 by 30 , we get 10 as the remainder 

The smallest four - digit number which is divisible by 2,3 and 5 = 1000 - 10 + 30 = 1020

The smallest four - digit number which when divided by 2,3 and 5 leaves remainder 1 in each case = ( 1020 +1) = 1021.

**Hence, the smallest four- digit number is 1021.**
